records.summary_text: Bangladesh is a dangerous destination for trans visitors, with escalating Islamist violence since the August 2024 political crisis that ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Trans activist Shila was brutally murdered in February 2025 (police suspect extremist involvement). A human-rights group documented 260 anti-LGBTQI+ incidents in 2024 — including murder, arson, and blackmail — describing attacks as having "skyrocketed." records.name: Vietnam
records.summary_text:
Vietnam is broadly workable — described as one of the most tolerant countries in the region toward sexual minorities. Same-sex conduct is not criminalised, and the 2015 Civil Code (Article 37) was a landmark recognising transgender people's right to change their legal gender. However, the implementing Gender Affirmation Law has been stalled for over eight years — the right exists on paper but not in practice. There is no anti-discrimination law covering gender identity.
